note: Alberta Parks campground 83 km southwest of Nordegg on Highway 11, near the Banff National Park boundary: two well-treed loops either side of Thompson Creek, with a trail to views over the North Saskatchewan River valley. No cell coverage or debit. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the Alberta Parks page (updated Nov 2, 2026) and shop: 55 unserviced sites at C$28 plus 3 walk-in tent sites, season May 8 - Oct 3 (stored, manual), mixed reservable (1-33) and first-come (34-56). Wrote fees (note), sites (max 90 ft, pull-through), hookups, facilities (vault, no potable water), booking (fcfs some_sites + note); note rewritten (the old FCFS-loop closure line has no current advisory).

WEBSITE: both stored URLs answered 200. GOOGLE 4.6 from 145 reviews.

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - confirmed): the page says the PRA is 'on the banks of the North Saskatchewan River', but on the tear sheet (50 m scale) and imagery both RV loops sit in dense spruce well north of the river; Thompson Creek's gravel wash runs between the loops, crossed by a bridge near tent sites 57-59 (the only sites the shop tags 'Near Water', tent-only, 16-20 ft). No RV site on open ground beside the water.

PIN (52.01060,-116.62680): between the east (reservable) loop and the day-use/parking area, inside the campground on the tear sheet; the page's directions point 52.012064,-116.626304 is 166 m NE, Google's 52.01111,-116.62870 is 142 m W. Imagery here is dense canopy (loops not visible). No move.
